verdict.rationale: Twilio documents recording incoming calls without a person answering [twilio-docs-23] and AI-powered transcription of voice interactions [twilio-docs-5]. A hands-on user confirms they run voicemail-to-webhook with transcription [twilio-comm-15]. However, getting the transcript to email or chat is not built in: TwiML bins and Functions have no email capability, so you must host your own code or wire up SendGrid [twilio-comm-11]. Missing for 10: native voicemail-to-email/chat delivery, first-party voicemail transcription docs, and a no-code setup a founder could configure directly.
